verdict.rationale: The docs reference a `/models/apply` API endpoint and in-UI gallery installation and management of models. Both suggest models can be added to a running server, but no evidence explicitly says multiple models stay loaded together or that clients switch between them per request without a restart. missing for 10: explicit documentation of hot-loading and unloading models at runtime, per-request model switching among several loaded models, behaviour when concurrent models are loaded, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can load and switch between multiple models without restarting the server

citations.quote: PRELOAD_MODELS (or --preload-models) takes a list in JSON with the same parameter of the API calls of the /models/apply endpoint.
Install models from the built-in gallery (Discover page)
LocalAI comes with a **built-in web interface** for chatting with models, managing installations, configuring AI agents, and more, with no extra tools needed.
